contrast_or_allowed_values: Resistant genotype minus susceptible genotype at the same time point
description: Canonical primary differential-expression results from raw integer read counts using a DESeq2 negative-binomial generalized linear model with design ~ batch + condition. Condition is the 12-level genotype by time-point factor. ComBat, rlog, and VST values were not used for DEG testing. Only genes with padj_zero_null < 0.05 and abs(log2FC_apeglm) > 1 are included.

Unique gene identifier used as the row-level biological entity.
Mean DESeq2 size-factor-normalized count for the gene across all 36 samples in the fitted model. This is not expression for the individual contrast alone.

Unshrunken maximum-likelihood log2 fold-change estimate. Positive values indicate higher expression in the resistant genotype; negative values indicate lower expression. Values of +1 and -1 correspond to twofold higher and twofold lower expression, respectively.
apeglm-shrunken log2 fold-change estimate. This estimate supplies the direction and magnitude used by the canonical effect filter abs(log2FC_apeglm) > 1.
Uncertainty reported by DESeq2 for the apeglm-shrunken log2 fold-change estimate.
DESeq2 Wald-test statistic for the conventional zero-effect null hypothesis.

contrast_or_allowed_values: raw two-sided p-value for H0: log2FC = 0
description: Unadjusted DESeq2 Wald-test p-value. Blank fields represent unavailable estimates.
P-value adjusted across tested genes within the individual contrast. The primary definition requires padj_zero_null < 0.05.

contrast_or_allowed_values: raw p-value for H0: abs(log2FC) <= 1 versus H1: abs(log2FC) > 1
description: Unadjusted DESeq2 formal effect-size-threshold test p-value. This is a sensitivity analysis rather than the canonical primary call.
Threshold-test p-value adjusted across tested genes within the individual contrast.

contrast_or_allowed_values: apeglm false-sign-or-small s-value with log2FC threshold 1
description: Controls the expected fraction of selected genes having the wrong effect sign or an absolute true effect no greater than 1. Blank fields represent unavailable estimates.
TRUE when padj_threshold_test < 0.05. This formal effect-size-test call is retained as a sensitivity definition.
TRUE when padj_zero_null < 0.05 and abs(log2FC_apeglm) > 1.
Canonical manuscript-facing DEG call, identical to DE_zero_null_plus_effect_filter in this analysis. Every row in these nine filtered export files has DE_primary = TRUE.
Stringent emphasis tier: DE_primary_threshold_test is TRUE and FSOS_svalue < 0.01. This is not the primary DEG definition.
Resistant genotype used as the numerator of the fold-change comparison.
Sampling time in hours post inoculation.
Compact identifier joining the resistant genotype and sampling time.
Script used to filter canonical primary DE genes, sort rows, and write one result file per contrast. Rows are ordered by increasing padj_zero_null, decreasing abs(log2FC_apeglm), and gene identifier.
Computational environment recorded when the nine contrast files were exported.

contrast_or_allowed_values: several genotype by time-point cells occur in only one sequencing batch
description: The additive batch coefficient is estimable from batch-mixed cells, but comparisons involving single-batch cells rely on the assumption of a common additive batch effect.
